fault_metadata.description: Independently configurable sensor fault transformations for uncertainty and abstention benchmarking. Units: noise is relative to signal std or absolute g/m³; drift is in g/(m³·h) or relative std/h; delays are in seconds.

telemetry_delay.description: Telemetry arrival lag in seconds. Packets measured at time t arrive at central receiver at t + delay_sec. Monitoring series reflects latest available observation at query time.
